title: BEACON: Learning Observation-Conditioned Starting Points for Guided Conditional Flow Matching in Microscopy
abstract: arXiv:2611.32406v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fluorescence microscopy drives much of modern life science, but accessible imaging setups often yield images degraded by out-of-focus light, limited resolution, and strong signal-dependent noise. Computational restoration can recover high-quality images from such data, enabling cheaper and faster imaging at lower light dose, provided biologically meaningful structures are preserved. Guided conditional flow matching has recently shown strong results for microscopy dehazing and computational super-resolution by learning distributions of plausible restorations. However, it pairs each clean target with an independent standard Gaussian sample, so the starting point of every training path does not leverage the degraded observation. This arbitrary noise--target coupling can produce conflicting velocity targets and makes the conditional velocity field harder to learn. We present BEACON, a $BE$st-of-$K$ $A$daptive learned coupling for guided $C

translated_title: BEACON：学习观测条件化的起始点用于显微成像中的引导条件流匹配
translated_abstract: 荧光显微技术推动着现代生命科学的许多领域，但易于获取的成像装置往往产生因离焦光线、有限分辨率和强烈的信号依赖性噪声而退化的图像。计算恢复技术可以从这些数据中恢复高质量图像，从而在保留具有生物学意义的结构的前提下，实现更廉价、更快速、更低光剂量的成像。引导条件流匹配通过学习合理恢复结果的分布，最近在显微成像去雾和计算超分辨率方面取得了出色的成果。然而，该方法将每个干净目标与独立的标准高斯样本配对，因此每条训练路径的起始点并未利用退化的观测数据。这种任意的噪声—目标耦合可能产生相互冲突的速度目标，并使条件速度场更难学习。我们提出了BEACON，一种用于引导条件流匹配的最优K自适应学习耦合方法……（摘要内容不完整）
tldr: BEACON提出了一种最优K自适应学习耦合方法，利用退化观测来条件化引导条件流匹配的训练起始点，从而避免任意噪声—目标配对导致的速度目标冲突，提升显微图像恢复的学习效果。
